1: /* engine.js — núcleo Three.js: renderer, cena, câmera, luzes globais, input, loop, FPS. */
2: import * as THREE from 'three';
3: import C from './constants.js';
4: 
5: export function createEngine(canvas) {
6:   const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
7:   renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, C.RENDER.pixelRatioCap));
8:   renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
9: 
10:   const scene = new THREE.Scene();
11:   scene.background = new THREE.Color(C.RENDER.background);
12:   scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(C.RENDER.background, C.RENDER.fogNear, C.RENDER.fogFar);
13: 
14:   const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(C.RENDER.fov, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, C.RENDER.near, C.RENDER.far);
15:   camera.rotation.order = 'YXZ';
16:   scene.add(camera);
17: 
18:   const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x8899bb, 0x445566, 0.9);
19:   scene.add(hemi);
20:   const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404050, 0.45);
21:   scene.add(ambient);
22: 
23:   const input = {
24:     keys: new Set(),
25:     pressed: new Set(),
26:     mx: 0, my: 0, scroll: 0,
27:     locked: false,
28:     sens: C.INPUT.mouseSens,
29:   };
30: 
31:   const onKeyDown = (e) => {
32:     if (!input.keys.has(e.code)) input.pressed.add(e.code);
33:     input.keys.add(e.code);
34:   };
35:   const onKeyUp = (e) => input.keys.delete(e.code);
36:   let lastClientX = null, lastClientY = null;
37:   const onMouseMove = (e) => {
38:     // movementX/Y são unbounded mesmo SEM pointer lock; fallback clientX limita na borda da janela.
39:     if (e.movementX !== undefined) {
40:       input.mx += e.movementX; input.my += e.movementY;
41:     } else if (lastClientX !== null && lastClientY !== null) {
42:       input.mx += e.clientX - lastClientX;
43:       input.my += e.clientY - lastClientY;
44:     }
45:     lastClientX = e.clientX; lastClientY = e.clientY;
46:   };
47:   const onWheel = (e) => { input.scroll += Math.sign(e.deltaY); };
48:   const requestLock = () => {
49:     if (document.pointerLockElement === canvas) return;
50:     try { canvas.requestPointerLock(); } catch { /* fora de user gesture — Q/E cobrem */ }
51:   };
52:   const onMouseDown = (e) => {
53:     if (e.button !== 0) return;
54:     if (!input.keys.has('Mouse0')) input.pressed.add('Mouse0');
55:     input.keys.add('Mouse0');
56:     requestLock();
57:   };
58:   const onMouseUp = (e) => { if (e.button === 0) input.keys.delete('Mouse0'); };
59:   const onLockChange = () => { input.locked = document.pointerLockElement === canvas; };
60:   const ensureLock = () => { if (document.pointerLockElement !== canvas) requestLock(); };
61:   const onResize = () => {
62:     camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
63:     camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
64:     renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
65:   };
66:   window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
67:   window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
68:   document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
69:   window.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
70:   window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
71:   canvas.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });
72:   document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', onLockChange);
73:   window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
74: 
75:   function update(dt) {
76:     const d = dt > 0 ? dt : 0.016;
77:     const turn = (input.keys.has('KeyQ') || input.keys.has('ArrowLeft') ? 1 : 0) -
78:                  (input.keys.has('KeyE') || input.keys.has('ArrowRight') ? 1 : 0);
79:     if (turn !== 0) camera.rotation.y += turn * C.INPUT.turnSpeed * d;
80:     camera.rotation.y -= input.mx * input.sens;
81:     camera.rotation.x -= input.my * input.sens;
82:     const lim = Math.PI / 2 - 0.05;
83:     camera.rotation.x = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, camera.rotation.x));
84:     input.mx = 0; input.my = 0; input.scroll = 0;
85:   }
86: 
87:   let onFrame = null;
88:   let last = performance.now();
89:   let fpsAcc = 0, fpsFrames = 0;
90:   const fps = { value: 0 };
91: 
92:   function frame() {
93:     requestAnimationFrame(frame);
94:     const now = performance.now();
95:     const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
96:     last = now;
97:     fpsAcc += dt; fpsFrames++;
98:     if (fpsAcc >= 1) { fps.value = Math.round(fpsFrames / fpsAcc); fpsAcc = 0; fpsFrames = 0; }
99:     update(dt);
100:     onFrame?.(dt);
101:     renderer.render(scene, camera);
102:   }
103: 
104:   return {
105:     renderer, scene, camera, input, fps,
106:     wasPressed(code) {
107:       if (input.pressed.has(code)) { input.pressed.delete(code); return true; }
108:       return false;
109:     },
110:     requestLock,
111:     ensureLock,
112:     exitLock() { if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock(); },
113:     start(fn) { onFrame = fn; ensureLock(); frame(); },
114:   };
115: }

1: /* main.js — bootstrap: monta todos os módulos, FSM (menu/playing/gameover/win),
2:  * eventos (dano, kill, pickup, porta, lava, saída) e API de debug (QA).
3:  * window.__registerMod é definido no index.html (antes deste módulo rodar).
4:  */
5: import * as THREE from 'three';
6: import C from './constants.js';
7: import { makeMap, dist2D } from './map.js';
8: import { createEngine } from './engine.js';
9: import { buildLevel } from './level.js';
10: import { createPlayer } from './player.js';
11: import { createWeapons } from './weapons.js';
12: import { createProjectiles } from './projectiles.js';
13: import { createEnemies } from './enemies.js';
14: import { createParticles } from './particles.js';
15: import { createMinimap } from './minimap.js';
16: import { createHUD } from './hud.js';
17: import { createPickups, updatePickups } from './pickups.js';
18: import './audio.js';
19: 
20: const canvas = document.getElementById('game-canvas');
21: const engine = createEngine(canvas);
22: const map = makeMap();
23: const level = buildLevel(map, THREE);
24: engine.scene.add(level.group);
25: 
26: const player = createPlayer(engine, map);
27: const particles = createParticles(engine.scene);
28: const audio = window.__mods?.audio;
29: 
30: const projectiles = createProjectiles(engine.scene, {
31:   map,
32:   getPlayer: () => player,
33:   getEnemies: () => enemies.list,
34:   damagePlayer: (d) => applyDamage(d),
35:   onImpact: (x, y, z, type) => {
36:     if (type === 'rocket') {
37:       particles.fire(x, y, z, 14);
38:       particles.smoke(x, y, z, 8);
39:       audio?.play('explosion');
40:       engine.input.my += 4; engine.input.mx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
41:     } else {
42:       particles.fire(x, y, z, 8);
43:       audio?.play('hit');
44:     }
45:   },
46:   sparks: (x, y, z, n, color) => particles.sparks(x, y, z, n, color),
47: });
48: 
49: const enemies = createEnemies(engine.scene, map, {
50:   getPlayer: () => player,
51:   damagePlayer: (d) => applyDamage(d),
52:   spawnFireball: (x, y, z, dx, dz, owner) => projectiles.spawn('fireball', x, y, z, dx, dz, owner),
53:   meleeImpact: (x, z) => { particles.blood(x, 1, z, 6); audio?.play('hit'); },
54:   onKill: (en, x, z) => {
55:     player.kills += 1;
56:     particles.blood(x, 1, z, 10);
57:     audio?.play('kill');
58:     dropFrom(en, x, z);
59:   },
60: });
61: 
62: const weapons = createWeapons(engine, player, engine.scene, {
63:   map,
64:   getEnemies: () => enemies.list,
65:   shoot: () => audio?.play('shot'),
66:   noAmmo: () => audio?.play('noammo'),
67:   spawnProjectile: (o, dir) => projectiles.spawn('rocket', o.x, o.y, o.z, dir.x, dir.z),
68:   impact: (x, y, z) => { particles.sparks(x, y, z, 4); audio?.play('hit'); },
69: });
70: 
71: const minimap = createMinimap(document.getElementById('minimap'), map, () => ({
72:   player, enemies: enemies.list,
73: }));
74: 
75: const hud = createHUD(() => ({
76:   player, weapons,
77:   fps: engine.fps,
78:   locked: engine.input.locked,
79: }));
80: 
81: /* ---- pickups (módulo externo) --------------------------------------------- */
82: let pickups = createPickups(engine.scene, map);
83: 
84: function dropFrom(en, x, z) {
85:   const r = Math.random();
86:   if (r < C.PICKUPS.dropAmmoChance) {
87:     const type = en.type === 'baron' || en.type === 'demon' ? 'rocket' : r < C.PICKUPS.dropAmmoChance / 2 ? 'shell' : 'bullet';
88:     weapons.ammo[type] = Math.min(C.WEAPONS[type === 'shell' ? 'shotgun' : type === 'bullet' ? 'chaingun' : 'rocket'].ammoMax, (weapons.ammo[type] || 0) + C.PICKUPS.ammoAmounts[type]);
89:     hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.ammoAmounts[type]} ${type.toUpperCase()}`);
90:   } else if (r < C.PICKUPS.dropAmmoChance + C.PICKUPS.dropHealthChance) {
91:     player.heal(C.PICKUPS.health);
92:     hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.health} HEALTH`);
93:   }
94: }
95: 
96: /* ---- dano / morte / vitória ---------------------------------------------- */
97: function applyDamage(d) {
98:   if (player.dead) return;
99:   if (player.damage(d)) {
100:     hud.flashDamage(d);
101:     audio?.play('hurt');
102:   }
103:   if (player.dead) setState('gameover');
104: }
105: 
106: /* ---- FSM ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
107: let state = 'menu';
108: const screens = {
109:   menu: 'menu-screen',
110:   gameover: 'dead-screen',
111:   win: 'win-screen',
112: };
113: function setState(s) {
114:   state = s;
115:   for (const [k, id] of Object.entries(screens)) {
116:     document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('show', k === s);
117:   }
118:   if (s === 'playing' && !engine.input.locked) engine.requestLock();
119:   if (s !== 'playing' && document.pointerLockElement) engine.exitLock();
120: }
121: 
122: document.getElementById('btn-start').addEventListener('click', () => {
123:   audio?.init();
124:   setState('playing');
125: });
126: document.getElementById('btn-restart').addEventListener('click', () => location.reload());
127: document.getElementById('btn-win').addEventListener('click', () => location.reload());
128: 
129: /* ---- portas (proximidade) ------------------------------------------------- */
130: function handleDoors(dt) {
131:   for (const d of map.doors) {
132:     const dist = dist2D(player.x, player.z, d.c + 0.5, d.r + 0.5);
133:     const shouldOpen = dist < 1.3;
134:     if (shouldOpen !== d.open) {
135:       d.open = shouldOpen;
136:       if (shouldOpen) audio?.play('door');
137:     }
138:   }
139: }
140: 
141: /* ---- saída / lava / pickups ------------------------------------------------ */
142: function handleWorld(dt) {
143:   if (level.exitPos && dist2D(player.x, player.z, level.exitPos.x, level.exitPos.z) < 1.2 && state === 'playing') {
144:     hud.pushMessage('EXIT REACHED — VICTORY');
145:     setTimeout(() => setState('win'), 600);
146:   }
147:   const r = Math.floor(player.z), c = Math.floor(player.x);
148:   if (map.isLava(r, c) && !player.dead) {
149:     player.health = Math.max(0, player.health - C.LEVEL.lavaDamage * dt);
150:     hud.flashDamage(C.LEVEL.lavaDamage * dt);
151:     if (player.health <= 0 && !player.dead) {
152:       player.dead = true;
153:       setState('gameover');
154:     }
155:   }
156:   pickups = updatePickups(pickups, dt, player.x, player.z, 0.9, (p) => {
157:     audio?.play('pickup');
158:     if (p.type === 'health') {
159:       player.heal(C.PICKUPS.health);
160:       hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.health} HEALTH`);
161:     } else if (p.type === 'armor') {
162:       player.addArmor(C.PICKUPS.armor);
163:       hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.armor} ARMOR`);
164:     } else if (p.type === 'shotgun' || p.type === 'chaingun' || p.type === 'rocket') {
165:       const key = p.type;
166:       weapons.ammo[C.WEAPONS[key].ammoType] = Math.min(C.WEAPONS[key].ammoMax, (weapons.ammo[C.WEAPONS[key].ammoType] || 0) + C.WEAPONS[key].ammoStart);
167:       hud.pushMessage(`${key.toUpperCase()} ACQUIRED`);
168:     } else {
169:       const amount = C.PICKUPS.ammoAmounts[p.type];
170:       weapons.ammo[p.type] = Math.min(C.WEAPONS[p.type === 'bullet' ? 'chaingun' : p.type === 'shell' ? 'shotgun' : 'rocket'].ammoMax, (weapons.ammo[p.type] || 0) + amount);
171:       hud.pushMessage(`+${amount} ${p.type.toUpperCase()}`);
172:     }
173:   });
174: }
175: 
176: /* ---- loop principal -------------------------------------------------------- */
177: let t = 0;
178: engine.start((dt) => {
179:   t += dt;
180:   if (state === 'playing') {
181:     player.update(dt);
182:     weapons.update(dt);
183:     enemies.update(dt);
184:     projectiles.update(dt);
185:     level.update(dt);
186:     handleDoors(dt);
187:     handleWorld(dt);
188:   } else {
189:     projectiles.update(dt);
190:     level.update(dt);
191:   }
192:   particles.update(dt);
193:   minimap.draw();
194:   hud.update(dt);
195: });
196: 
197: /* ---- API de debug (QA Playwright) ------------------------------------------ */
198: window.__game = {
199:   get state() { return state; },
200:   engine, map, player, weapons, enemies, projectiles, particles, level,
201:   setState,
202:   getState() {
203:     return {
204:       player,
205:       weapons: {
206:         current: weapons.current,
207:         name: weapons.name,
208:         ammo: weapons.ammo,
209:       },
210:       enemies: enemies.list.map((e) => ({ type: e.type, x: e.x, z: e.z, hp: e.hp, dead: e.dead })),
211:       fps: engine.fps.value,
212:       locked: engine.input.locked,
213:     };
214:   },
215:   damagePlayer: (d) => applyDamage(d),
216:   killAll() { enemies.list.forEach((e) => enemies.damageEnemy(e, 9999)); },
217:   giveAmmo(type, n) { weapons.ammo[type] = (weapons.ammo[type] || 0) + n; },
218:   setWeapon(i) { weapons.select(i); },
219:   teleport(x, z) { player.x = x; player.z = z; },
220:   toggleMute() { return audio?.toggleMute(); },
221: };
222: 
223: export default { engine, player };

(End of file - total 223 lines)
</content>

2:  * barras, crosshair, vignette de dano, CRT e telas FSM. */

4: /* ---- tokens de design ------------------------------------------------------- */
5: :root {

7:   --bg-1: #06080c;
8:   --bg-2: #10141a;
9:   --line: #2a3038;
10:   --line-strong: #4a5260;
11:   --ink-hi: #f0f4f8;

13:   --ink-mid: #9aa4b0;
14:   --ink-lo: #6a7380;
15:   --amber: #ffcc55;

17:   --hp-good: #5a9a44;
18:   --hp-warn: #ccaa33;
19:   --hp-bad: #cc3333;
20:   --hud-bg: rgba(6, 8, 12, 0.82);
21:   --font-mono: 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace;
22:   --shadow-hard: 1px 1px 0 #000;
